card.title: Let Me Carry It
card.instruction: Take responsibility for managing everyone’s emotional burden, deciding what they should know, feel, and face.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take the condolence calls about Dad. You haven't slept.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want to speak to Aunt June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll check whether she's crying before I put her through.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She wants me to comfort her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll comfort her first. You can have each other once I've got you both steady.
